metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 회전 보간 ② 같은 자세를 다른 표현으로 옮기기
metadata.description:

englishMetadata.title: Game Mathematics Part 2: Rotation Interpolation 2 — Converting the Same Orientation
englishMetadata.description:
Does an orientation remain the same when we rewrite it as angles, a quaternion or a matrix? Following the same body’s forward and up directions, we establish coordinate and multiplication conventions, then connect conversion with reversal. Finally, we rotate and reverse a vector to check that its direction and length are restored. This is the second lecture on interpolation and rotation conversions.

Game Math PART2 course materials
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and 60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Overview: numbers for the same orientation
00:18 Conventions before the conversion graph
02:23 Length and atan2 with small numbers
02:58 Euler angles and matrices: a round trip
03:49 Build matrix axes from a quaternion
04:54 Different numbers for the same body orientation
06:09 Protect division when extracting rotation
06:38 Recover a quaternion at a half turn
07:45 Connect Euler angles and quaternions
09:51 Recover axis and angle at zero and a half turn
10:53 Check an intermediate orientation and a round trip
11:34 Rotate and reverse the same vector
12:59 Conventions and verification
13:31 From rotation to lines and bounds
13:51 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.
